_meta.purpose: Phase 2 / 2A automation-flag validation set. Human ground truth for whether two tickets genuinely share the same underlying fix, used to adjudicate whether production resolution clustering should swap from minilm@0.80 to bge@0.90.
_meta.how_to_label: For each pair, read both resolution texts and set "label" to exactly one of: "same_fix" (one automation would resolve both), "different_fix" (they need different fixes), or "unclear" (genuinely cannot tell). Optionally add a short "label_reason". Do not leave any label null.
_meta.blind_by_design: This file deliberately omits scenario_id and does not say which configuration co-clustered each pair. Both are in automation_flag_validation_key.json, which the scorer reads and the labeller should not.
_meta.precision_over_recall: The production design choice is that a false 'these share a fix' claim is costlier than a missed automation opportunity. When genuinely torn between same_fix and different_fix, that asymmetry is the tie-breaker; use "unclear" only when the texts do not support a judgement at all.
